description: Cheap Agent: SessionStart adds a one-line pointer to the delegate tool; the edit guard (edits and Bash file writes) is off until /cheapag:hook on, and its shell test keeps it free (no npx) while off.

hooks.command: r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -f "$r/.cheapag/hook.json" ] && npx -y cheap-agent@0.1.0 hook guard; exit 0
